# International Journal of Sports Physical Therapy (IJSPT)

> > A peer-reviewed journal publishing research on sports injury prevention, rehabilitation protocols, return-to-sport testing, and evidence-based physical therapy interventions for athletes.

IJSPT (International Journal of Sports Physical Therapy) publishes original research, systematic reviews, case reports, and clinical guidelines spanning biomechanics, injury prevention, rehabilitation algorithms, and performance testing across diverse athletic populations. The journal emphasizes velocity-based training, neurocognitive testing, ACL rehabilitation, and sport-specific functional assessments.

## Key Topics

- ACL reconstruction and rehabilitation
- Return-to-sport testing protocols
- Injury prevention strategies
- Quadriceps strength assessment
- Knee loading biomechanics
- Velocity-based training (VBT)
- Elastic band training and resistance exercise
- OMNI-Resistance Exercise Scale (OMNI-RES)
- Mean propulsive velocity monitoring
- Isometric testing methods
- Youth baseball injury prevention
- Overhead athlete rehabilitation
- Neurocognitive assessment
- Postpartum athlete recovery
- Musculoskeletal ultrasound diagnostics

## ACL Injury and Knee Rehabilitation

- [A Preliminary Investigation into the Neural Correlates of Knee Loading during a Change of Direction Task in Individuals after Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction](https://ijspt.scholasticahq.com/article/57782-a-preliminary-investigation-into-the-neural-correlates-of-knee-loading-during-a-change-of-direction-task-in-individuals-after-anterior-cruciate-ligame): fMRI study of CNS function & knee biomechanics post-ACLR by Grooms et al.
- [Altered Knee Loading Following Primary ACL Repair versus ACL Reconstruction](https://ijspt.scholasticahq.com/article/77362-altered-knee-loading-following-primary-acl-repair-versus-acl-reconstruction): ACL repair vs reconstruction knee biomechanics comparison by Singleton et al.
- [ACL Rehabilitation Plateaus Across Athlete Populations: Two Case Reports and a Clinical Framework for Identifying Functional Stagnation](https://ijspt.scholasticahq.com/article/156102-acl-rehabilitation-plateaus-across-athlete-populations-two-case-reports-and-a-clinical-framework-for-identifying-functional-stagnation): ACL rehab plateau identification framework with case reports by Kumar et al.

## Return-to-Sport Testing and Rehabilitation Protocols

- [Neurocognitive and Reactive Return to Play Testing Protocol in Overhead Athletes Following Upper Extremity Injury](https://ijspt.scholasticahq.com/article/89926-neurocognitive-and-reactive-return-to-play-testing-protocol-in-overhead-athletes-following-upper-extremity-injury): Reactive neurocognitive RTP testing for overhead athletes by Wilk et al.
- [A Rehabilitation Algorithm After Lateral Ankle Sprains in Professional Football (Soccer): An Approach Based on Clinical Practice Guidelines](https://ijspt.scholasticahq.com/article/120205-a-rehabilitation-algorithm-after-lateral-ankle-sprains-in-professional-football-soccer-an-approach-based-on-clinical-practice-guidelines): Criteria-based ankle sprain rehab algorithm for soccer players by Flore et al.
- [Maximizing Recovery in the Postpartum Period: A Timeline for Rehabilitation from Pregnancy through Return to Sport](https://ijspt.scholasticahq.com/article/37863-maximizing-recovery-in-the-postpartum-period-a-timeline-for-rehabilitation-from-pregnancy-through-return-to-sport): Postpartum athlete rehabilitation timeline & recommendations by Selman et al.
- [Effectiveness of Vestibular Rehabilitation in Children Post-Concussion: A Systematic Review](https://ijspt.scholasticahq.com/article/128282-effectiveness-of-vestibular-rehabilitation-in-children-post-concussion-a-systematic-review): Systematic review of vestibular rehab for pediatric concussion by Tiwari et al.

## Strength Assessment and Training Methods

- [Psychological and Physical Predictors of Perceived Effort in Elastic Band Training: A Velocity-Based Approach](https://ijspt.scholasticahq.com/article/142236-psychological-and-physical-predictors-of-perceived-effort-in-elastic-band-training-a-velocity-based-approach): Research on RPE & velocity-based elastic band training by Colado et al.
- [Effects of Sex and Age on Quadriceps and Hamstring Strength and Flexibility in High School Basketball Athletes](https://ijspt.scholasticahq.com/article/27986-effects-of-sex-and-age-on-quadriceps-and-hamstring-strength-and-flexibility-in-high-school-basketball-athletes): Isokinetic strength normative values for high school basketball by Nagai et al.
- [Femur Length is Correlated with Isometric Quadriceps Strength in Post-Operative Patients](https://ijspt.scholasticahq.com/article/35704-femur-length-is-correlated-with-isometric-quadriceps-strength-in-post-operative-patients): Femur length correlation with quadriceps strength post-surgery by Dean et al.
- [Excellent Reliability for an Instrumented Test of Ankle Plantarflexion Force](https://ijspt.scholasticahq.com/article/128591-excellent-reliability-for-an-instrumented-test-of-ankle-plantarflexion-force): Test-retest reliability of ankle plantarflexion force testing by Glaied et al.

## Sport-Specific Athlete Assessment

- [Periscapular Strength Profile Changes in Collegiate Baseball Pitchers Over the Course of a Season](https://ijspt.scholasticahq.com/article/117398-periscapular-strength-profile-changes-in-collegiate-baseball-pitchers-over-the-course-of-a-season): Seasonal periscapular strength changes in NCAA pitchers by Pabian et al.
- [Cumulative Effects of a Week's Training Loads on Shoulder Physical Qualities and Wellness in Competitive Swimmers](https://ijspt.scholasticahq.com/article/29875-cumulative-effects-of-a-week-s-training-loads-on-shoulder-physical-qualities-and-wellness-in-competitive-swimmers): Weekly training load effects on swimmer shoulder health by Yoma et al.
- [Baseline Functional Testing in Competitive Youth Swimmers](https://ijspt.scholasticahq.com/article/146224-baseline-functional-testing-in-competitive-youth-swimmers): Upper extremity normative values for youth swimmers by Naftilan et al.
- [The Effect of Running Speed on Cadence and Running Kinetics](https://ijspt.scholasticahq.com/article/140544-the-effect-of-running-speed-on-cadence-and-running-kinetics): Running speed effects on cadence & ground reaction forces by Leacox et al.

## Injury Prevention and Screening

- [Survey with Innovations to Increase Response Rate Reveals Low Compliance with Guidelines among Youth Baseball Coaches](https://ijspt.scholasticahq.com/article/32978-survey-with-innovations-to-increase-response-rate-reveals-low-compliance-with-guidelines-among-youth-baseball-coaches-including-a-survey-of-differen): Youth baseball coach compliance with pitch count limits by Kaizu et al.
- [Collegiate Student-Athlete Perception of Value and Programming Barriers in Pre-Participation Movement Screen Implementation](https://ijspt.scholasticahq.com/article/137689-collegiate-student-athlete-perception-of-value-and-programming-barriers-in-pre-participation-movement-screen-implementation): Student-athlete views on FMS & pre-participation screening by Snider et al.

## Diagnostic and Clinical Tools

- [Diagnostic Musculoskeletal Ultrasound in the Evaluation of the Plantar Fascia](https://ijspt.scholasticahq.com/article/141177-diagnostic-musculoskeletal-ultrasound-in-the-evaluation-of-the-plantar-fascia): MSK ultrasound guide for plantar fascia diagnosis by Manske et al.

## Optional

- [Development and Implementation of a Critical Care Transport Physical Ability Test: An Administrative Case Report](https://ijspt.scholasticahq.com/article/143487-development-and-implementation-of-a-critical-care-transport-physical-ability-test-an-administrative-case-report): Physical ability test development for med flight teams by Bradley et al.
